origin: Full Time Sports emerged from the vibrant, albeit chaotic, world of Brazilian amateur racing in the late 1990s. Founded by Ricardo Santos, a wealthy Sao Paulo businessman with a lifelong passion for motorsport, the team initially served as a playground for Santos and his friends. What started as weekend track days quickly escalated into a serious, albeit localized, racing endeavor. A pivotal moment arrived during the 2003 Paulista Endurance Championship when, against all odds, their aging Porsche 911 (generously funded by Santos) managed to clinch a podium finish, sparking a newfound ambition to compete at a higher level and invest more seriously.
philosophy: Full Time Sports operates under the ethos of 'win or learn.' While they possess a relatively substantial budget for an amateur team, they prioritize experience and seat time over cutting-edge technology. Car development is largely driven by driver feedback and on-track experimentation. The team culture is relaxed and familial, emphasizing camaraderie and a shared love of racing above all else, although the pressure to deliver for their generous benefactor is always present.
achievements: Multiple class wins in various regional Brazilian GT series (2005-2010)
Consistent top-10 finishes in the Brazilian V8 Stock Car Light series (2012-2015)
Winner of the 2018 Rio Grande do Sul Endurance Series

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Santos
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo Santos is the founder and team principal, a successful businessman who made his fortune in the coffee industry. He's known for his hands-on approach and unwavering support for the team, often seen in the garage offering encouragement and, occasionally, unsolicited advice.

keyFigures.name: Isabela Oliveira
keyFigures.description: Isabela is a highly respected figure in the Brazilian racing scene, known for her encyclopedic knowledge of engines and her ability to coax performance out of even the most temperamental machinery.

keyFigures.name: Joao Paulo Costa
keyFigures.description: Joao Paulo is a talented and experienced driver who has been with the team since its inception. He is known for his smooth driving style and his ability to consistently deliver results.

headquarters: Full Time Sports is based out of a modest workshop located on the outskirts of Sao Paulo. While the facilities are relatively basic, they are well-maintained and equipped with the essentials for preparing and running their race cars. The team also has a small hospitality area for sponsors and guests.
fanBase: Full Time Sports enjoys a loyal following within the local Brazilian racing community. Their fans are drawn to the team's underdog spirit, the family atmosphere, and the fact that they represent a true passion project fueled by the love of the sport.
